checkpointSelection.perFold: highest validation onset+string+fret F1 among checkpoints that do not violate any already-computable hard gate; ties by higher note-event completeness, then lower abstention rate, then earlier checkpoint

evaluationPopulation.aggregation: average accepted capture views within each underlying performance, then macro-average underlying performances so performances with more surviving views do not receive extra weight

failurePolicy.anyRequiredThresholdFailure: development candidate fails closed; do not open P3
failurePolicy.emptyClass: fail closed for that fold/content class

abstentionRate.definition: eligible evaluation frames for which the system returns no usable six-string state because an explicit development guard abstains, divided by eligible evaluation frames

crossPerformerConsistency.definition: absolute difference between the two performer-disjoint fold metrics

frameStringFretAccuracy.definition: exact state accuracy per physical string on active-union frames where reference or prediction is non-silent; macro-average six strings, then performances

noteEventCompleteness.definition: sum temporal intersection duration of onset-matched exact-string/fret predicted/reference events divided by total reference event duration

onsetStringFret.f1: harmonic mean of precision and recall
onsetStringFret.match: one-to-one exact physical string and fret, maximize match count then minimize onset error

publishedAnchor.comparability: directional-anchor-only; published frame/tablature metrics and validation design are not claimed equivalent to Astra exact onset+string+fret metrics
